verdict.rationale: Rippling's own IAM page claims it is an identity system that holds both people and agents (docs-23), and it surfaces AI tools and OAuth grants in use across the org (docs-2), so agents as identities is a stated capability. However, these are single marketing lines with no documented patterns for actually securing agent access. The scoped Bearer API tokens (docs-22) cover access to Rippling's own API in general, not credentials built for agents, so they are adjacent and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented agent-identity lifecycle and patterns, cross-app access for agents, token vaulting, scoped per-agent credentials to third-party apps, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
